summary.text: Nicole Sabel is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Jen Strebs (D) and Rafael Wolf (L); there is no incumbent in the race.
According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, after losing the 2024 Republican primary in the district to Terry Haines.
